player_prompt.intro:
A si Jowee {player_id} e Chopsticks. E jaawndo, si gooto o: 
  + Wonande:  '[attack M O]'  humpito M=handu baawɗo (0 walla 1), O=handu mawɗo (0 walla 1).
    - Handu mawɗo jangi e woodani e handu baawɗo; to wiɗi 5, e wiɗi 0.
  + Desdi:   '[split L R]'  e des handu baawɗo e woodani e L e R (L+R = woodani baawɗo).
Si e woodani o o.

invalid_move.split_no_change: Split sey waylita sendol juuɗe ma.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Dabbal ɓilaago. Fooɗo “[attack M O]” walla “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} yahri P{opp_id} e ɓeydu {opp_idx}: o yahi e {opp_val} yaahi {new_val}.
